session.streamInterrupted: Event stream interrupted. The agent keeps running; reconnecting from the last event.
session.streamClosed: stream closed after the terminal event
session.cancelDescription: The worker stops at the next safe node boundary. Completed tool side effects, patches, events and costs are kept.
session.cancelCooperative: Cancellation is cooperative and idempotent. Containers or processes owned by other projects are never touched.

stopped.label: Stopped

failed.description: The run did not produce a verified result

uncertain.description: The worker died and side effects cannot be proven

stages.working: Agent is working through the workflow…
stages.noEventsDescription: The worker writes events as soon as it claims the task. This view reconnects automatically.

final.unverified: Run finished without an M2 claim
final.internalHint: — decided only by the internal closure
final.officialAuthoritative: official result is authoritative and independent
final.officialNotRecorded: NOT RECORDED — no official harness report was archived

panels.finalPatchHint: The final patch is written by finalize. Partial file edits stay in the agent workspace until then.
panels.noPatchDescription: This run did not produce a final diff. The report explains which verification stages were not executed.
panels.identityNote: The patch identity could not be verified.
panels.diffTruncated: The API truncated this diff. Select a file below; the backend can return a single file on demand.
panels.selectFile: Select a file to inspect its diff.
panels.diffsReadonly: Diffs are read-only; the dashboard never writes to the agent workspace.
panels.noChangedFilesDescription: The final diff is written by finalize. If the run stopped before a patch, this list stays empty.
panels.clickToJump: Open a changed file to jump directly to its diff. Paths are repository-relative; no host path is accepted by the API.
panels.verificationRunningDescription: Target tests, regression and review details are written when the run reaches finalize.
panels.noReportDescription: The run ended without a report artifact. The event timeline may still contain the last known state.
panels.budgetStop: Stopped by a budget rule. This is not a model failure claim. Reason: {{reason}}.
panels.reviewUnavailable: Review details are not available yet
panels.reviewUnavailableDescription: The independent reviewer writes its verdict near the end of the run.
panels.reviewerNotExecuted: Reviewer NOT EXECUTED. This is not a pass. The run did not reach the review preconditions or ran out of review allowance.
panels.officialIndependentReview: The official SWE-bench verdict is independent and is never used to fill in a missing internal review.
panels.reviewerScope: Reviewer approval only describes this candidate patch. It does not replace the official harness verdict or the internal verification level.
panels.notRecordedEventLog: NOT RECORDED in the event log
panels.noReportMarkdownDescription: The report is written by finalize. A cancelled or failed run may not have produced one.

history.title: Historical runs

benchmarks.noneDescription: Completed evaluation packages appear here after they are registered in the read-only catalog.

models.title: Providers
models.intro: Credentials are stored server-side. The browser only sees whether a credential is configured and where it comes from.
models.noProvidersDescription: Add a provider to make the default model and live routing available.
models.noMatchesDescription: Adjust the search or turn off the favorites filter.
models.deleteConfirm: Delete provider {{name}}? Its encrypted credential is removed. This is refused while agent routing still points at it.
models.credentialEnvHint: The worker reads the value from its process environment or .env. No value is stored in the browser.
models.credentialStoredHint: The value is encrypted at rest and never returned by the API.
models.credentialRevokeConfirm: Revoke the stored credential for {{name}}? New live tasks will fail closed until a new credential is configured.
models.deleteModelConfirm: Delete model {{id}}? This is refused while agent routing still points at it.
models.discoverHint: Fetches the provider's model catalogue only when you click. Results are not saved until you add them.
models.inferenceConfirm: Test inference can incur provider charges. It sends one tiny request (max 16 output tokens) and never starts the coding agent. Continue?
models.toolDeclared: Tool calling is declared by the model configuration but is not verified by this test.
models.toolNotSupported: Tool calling is not supported by this model.
models.providerIdHint: Immutable after creation; task snapshots reference it.
models.baseUrlHint: HTTPS only. Private, loopback and metadata addresses are rejected before any request.
models.awsHint: Bedrock uses the AWS SDK credential chain. Do not paste an IAM secret into an API key field.
models.catalogHint: Choose a built-in template or create an OpenAI-compatible custom provider.
models.customHint: Any HTTPS endpoint that speaks the selected protocol.
models.modelsEmpty: No models yet. Add one before routing agents to this provider.
models.modelPriceHint: Live routing fails closed when input or output price is missing, or when the currency cannot be converted to the budget currency.
models.credentialRequired: Configure a credential before testing authentication.
models.routingIsNotVerification: “Live routing conditions met” only means the configuration, credential, pricing and budget admission checks pass. It does not prove that a real provider request succeeded. “Real inference verified” appears only when a traceable successful inference record exists.

agents.title: Agent model routing
agents.intro: Task-specific selection beats role overrides, which beat the global default. Running tasks keep their frozen snapshot.
agents.defaultHint: Used for every role without an override, and for new live tasks.
agents.reasoningUnsupported: This model does not declare reasoning support.

roleHint.localizer: Selects files and symbols to read.
roleHint.planner: Plans the repair and may call read-only tools.
roleHint.coder: Generates and iterates on the patch; requires tool calling.
roleHint.diagnoser: Explains failing tests and proposes corrections.

agents.missingModel: Add a complete provider model before selecting a default.
agents.compatibilityOk: This model satisfies the live routing requirements.

permissions.title: Permissions & sandbox
permissions.intro: These controls are enforced by the server. The dashboard cannot grant capabilities that the worker does not have.
permissions.repositoryHostsHint: Configured by the administrator. The API rejects other hosts before cloning.
permissions.executionBackendHint: fake is an explicitly simulated sandbox; docker is required for live model tasks.
permissions.networkPolicyHint: The worker does not enable package-network access during repository builds.
permissions.toolAllowlistHint: Read-only view of the tools the graph can expose. Changing this list requires a code change; no dashboard toggle can bypass the workspace policy.
permissions.dangerousActionsValue: Cancellation is cooperative; data cleanup requires typing DELETE and only affects finished user tasks.
permissions.workspaceBoundaryValue: Reads and writes are confined to the run workspace. Host paths are never accepted from the browser.
permissions.sandboxLimitsValue: The sandbox contains repository test execution. It is not a multi-tenant security boundary and does not protect against a malicious Docker daemon.
permissions.liveSandboxRequirement: Live model tasks require the Docker sandbox backend unless a server-side test override is enabled.

budget.title: Execution & budget defaults
budget.intro: These values seed new tasks. Each task gets a frozen budget; editing settings never changes a running task.
budget.exchangeRatesHint: Required when a model is priced in another currency. Missing rates make live routing fail closed.
budget.maxCostHint: Live tasks always require a positive per-task cap. Leave blank for offline runs.
budget.parallelHint: Admission is checked before a live task is queued.
budget.hardCaps: Server hard limits still apply; values above them are rejected.
budget.invalidNumbers: Enter valid numbers within the allowed ranges.

workspace.title: Workspace & data
workspace.intro: Artifacts are stored under the server's artifact root. Historical benchmark packages are read-only and outside this cleanup scope.
workspace.workspaceValue: Repository selection is per task. The default below only prefills the form.
workspace.historyValue: Read-only catalog entries are never deleted by the dashboard.
workspace.exportHint: Exports provider definitions and preferences without plaintext credentials.
workspace.importHint: Vault references are rejected on import; re-enter credentials after importing.
workspace.cleanupHint: Deletes only finished user tasks, their queue events and their per-run artifact directories. Historical benchmarks and running tasks are never touched.

advanced.title: Advanced diagnostics
advanced.intro: Runtime facts are read-only. Provider diagnostics never include credentials.
advanced.logsHint: Only recent API/worker event summaries are shown; provider credentials and absolute paths are scrubbed.

about.title: About CodePilot-Repair
about.intro: A repository-level autonomous repair agent with a durable API, an independent worker and a real M2 LangGraph workflow.
about.architectureValue: React dashboard → authenticated FastAPI → SQLite queue → independent worker → M2 LangGraph → Docker sandbox or explicit fake backend.
about.docsHint: Documents load through the authenticated API; they are never exposed as unauthenticated static files.
about.licenseValue: This repository does not declare a project license in-tree. Third-party dependencies retain their own licenses.
about.disclaimer: Fake and live runs are labelled separately. Official SWE-bench verdicts are never inferred from UI state.
